# RORUBARU

> RORUBARU (Roru Baru, RORUBARU 手卷吧) is Hong Kong's original hand roll bar: Tokyo-style hand rolls (temaki, 手卷) made to order at a bar counter in Wan Chai, with warm seasoned rice, crisp Japanese nori, draught sake and highballs.

- Address: G/F, 100-102 Queen's Road East, Wan Chai, Hong Kong (MTR Wan Chai, Exit D, about 450 m)
- Hours: Open daily 12:00–22:00 (last order 21:30)
- Seating: bar counter only; walk-ins welcome, or book a seat online
- Phone: +852 6317 5675 · Email: hello@rorubaru.com
- Prices: in HKD, plus a 10% service charge. Hand roll sets from HK$218 (4 rolls); single rolls HK$38–108
- Happy hour: selected drinks, Mon–Fri 12pm–7pm
- Head chef: Joey Chan

## Key pages

- [Menu](https://www.rorubaru.com/menu): full à la carte, lunch and drinks menu with prices
- [Reserve](https://www.exploretock.com/roru-baru): book a counter seat on Tock
- [Delivery](https://www.rorubaru.com/delivery): foodpanda and Keeta
- [Events](https://www.rorubaru.com/events): guest-chef nights and Friday DJ night (RORU AFTER DARK, Fridays from 8pm)
- [About](https://www.rorubaru.com/about): the story of the bar
- [繁體中文](https://www.rorubaru.com/zh-Hant) · [日本語](https://www.rorubaru.com/ja)
